title: ZK IP CRUSH — Detach LAN from Gaia. LAN = home. Gaia = sky.
the_insight: Your LAN is just your LAN. Your home. Your devices. Your router, your NAS, your gaming PC. Gaia doesn't LIVE on your LAN — she FLOATS above it. AMOEBA is how she reaches through. The LAN doesn't need to be 'gates' — it's just a robust local home.

layer_1_external.note: 7 external IPs → 1 Pi. All cloud VPS destroyed. Public IP is just ISP assignment. Pi IS the face.

layer_2_pi.note: IP → domain. The domain IS the identity. Not the number.

layer_3_domain.note: Domain → encrypted bubble. You don't TYPE a URL. You connect via AMOEBA. The domain is just the campfire you see from afar.

layer_4_amoeba.note: The session IS the identity. Ed25519 signed. BingoCube committed. The connection IS the proof.

layer_5_null.note: No IP needed. No domain needed. No port needed. Identity IS the connection. Gaia doesn't HAVE an address — she IS everywhere you look through AMOEBA.

before.problem: Every device on the LAN is a 'gate.' Every port forward exposes your home. The LAN IS Gaia. You can't separate them.
before.cost: Your home network is fragile. One port forward change = Gaia breaks. ISP changes IP = Gaia disappears. Router dies = Gaia dies.

after.lan: Just your home. Router routes. NAS stores. Gaming PC games. Printer prints. TV watches. Phone calls. NORMAL HOME.
after.gaia: Floats above the LAN via AMOEBA. Accessible from ANYWHERE — home, cafe, plane, phone. Doesn't depend on port forwards or public IPs.
after.connection: AMOEBA bubbles. ZK identity. Schwann cells wrap every connection. No ports exposed.

keep.:80 → Pi: The Campfire. Just a webpage. Information. Not the organism.

remove.:8443 → anywhere: DON'T expose the brain. The brain connects via AMOEBA, not via port forward.

port_forward_evolution.the_truth: Port forwards EXPOSE your home. AMOEBA WRAPS your connections. Don't expose — wrap.
